up: For the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1140846', retrieve all distinct molecules that appear in that document. For each molecule, return: its ChEMBL ID (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), its maximum development phase (molecule_dictionary.max_phase), its molecule type (molecule_dictionary.molecule_type), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Join docs on docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140846' to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and left join to compound_structures on molregno to bring in SMILES (if present). Apply no row limit, no additional filters on activity data, confidence scores, or any other columns. Deduplicate to ensure each molecule appears only once.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id INNER JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1140846'
